name: Donald's Cantina Custom White Rice Bowl or Flour Burrito
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Treasure · Donald's Cantina (Festival of Foods)
whyItWorks: Build-your-own line lets you combine a soft white flour tortilla or steamed rice base with slow-braised carnitas/chicken, shredded cheese, and smooth guacamole while skipping every trigger.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order a white flour burrito or rice bowl with chicken or pork carnitas, shredded cheddar/Monterey Jack, plain sour cream, and smooth avocado mash. Strictly skip the hard corn taco shells, whole black/pinto beans, corn salsa, raw onions, and the hot sauce bar.
watchOuts: Whole black/pinto beans and roasted corn salsa
Salsa bar chili heat and lime juice
